title: Construction of a robust sepsis prognostic classifier based on E3 ubiquitin ligase-related genes.

models.outcome_definition: survival / mortality (GSE65682 follow-up displayed to 25 days; GSE95233 and in-house GSE294985 survival status)
models.verbatim_formula: URS = HLA-DRB1 x (-0.19) + LTB x (-0.28) + TCP11L2 x (0.27)
models.expression_scale_used: unclear (GSE65682 array expression; in-house RNA-seq for GSE294985; normalization not stated)
models.cutoff: median URS in training set GSE65682
models.reported_performance: GSE65682 training: KM significant; prognostic AUC 0.656 (Nomogram with clinical variables 0.706). GSE95233 and GSE294985 (n=30 sepsis): significant KM separation (p in figures). Meta-analysis pooled HR 3.21 (1.26-8.14) for continuous URS, 2.58 (1.67-3.98) for high vs low group.
models.source_location: Results 'Establishment of ubiquitination-related sepsis prognostic model' (formula) + Fig. 4H, Fig. 5, Suppl Fig. S3

notes: Pipeline: limma DEGs in GSE65682 (sepsis vs control) x 997 E3 ligase genes -> univariate Cox (37 genes) -> consensus clustering of all 802 GSE65682 samples (and separately GSE95233) into 2 clusters with different survival -> DEGs between clusters + univariate Cox (94) -> LASSO/CoxBoost/RSF consensus (8 genes) -> multivariable Cox; the final formula contains only 3 genes although text says Cox was run on 8 (selection step to 3 not described). 'Other' role cohorts (GSE54514, GSE131761, GSE137340, GSE236713, GSE28750, GSE57065, GSE69528) were used for diagnostic ROC/meta-analysis of URS, LTB and TCP11L2 - GSE236713 (target cohort) and GSE54514 were thus used for this model (diagnosis only). GSE95233 also re-clustered and used for prognostic validation. In-house GSE294985: 30 sepsis + 10 healthy. The 37-gene cluster model gene list is only in Supplementary Table S2 (not downloaded) and clusters were derived including healthy controls, so not recorded as a separate model.
